reviews.name: Reid Ennis
reviews.text: They will get you in quick! Awesome mechanics. Fix anything. Owners are cool too!

reviews.name: Rick Valenta
reviews.text: They do good work at fair prices here. A pleasure to work with all around.

reviews.name: Max Jennings
reviews.text: I usually don't write reviews, but this business was incredible to work with. I walked into the shop nervous because I don't know a ton about suspension. All I knew was that I needed new leaf springs to account for the added weight in my
reviews.ownerReply: Max, thank you so much for stopping in and for taking the time to leave this review. We really appreciate your business & your kind words! Take care.

reviews.name: Marc Blaine
reviews.text: Brake and spring work from light duty to heavy duty trucks.

reviews.name: Eddie Webbinaro
reviews.text: You can tell this family run business is proud of what they do, shows in the service and the work.
reviews.ownerReply: Eddie, thanks so much for taking the time to share your experience; we appreciate the business very much! Fingers crossed for snow, soon, so you can put that plow to good use! Take care.

reviews.name: Seth Mellinger
reviews.text: These guys did a great job on a project truck of mine, and happily did some fabrication work that other shops wouldn't even consider attempting. Great welding skills, reasonable prices, and capable of non-standard automotive work. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: George Talatinian
reviews.text: First time using their services. They came recommended and now l know why. They did a great job repairing my truck. It was clear they have the experience and know how to do the job correctly the first time. The entire staff was friendly and professional.

reviews.name: Ed Buckley
reviews.text: We had a breakdown with a trailer on the way home to Mass Sunday late afternoon. We left the trailer and they fixed it (broken springs)promptly with a very short notice from us.

reviews.name: Corey Norris
reviews.text: I went there to get a leaf fixed on one side of my F150. It turned out both sides were broken. From the initial phone call I found them to be professional, accommodating and knowledgeable. I thought the price was very reasonable and I would recommend them to anyone that needs the service.

reviews.name: Travis Weeks
reviews.text: They did a great job on my truck excellent service and great staff to work with. Welding skills are top notch! I wouldn't take my vehicles anywhere else! Thank you all for the hard work.

reviews.name: Sam Lincoln
reviews.text: For those of us that run heavy equipment, the service at McLeod’s is second to none. They’ve bent over backwards to get me out of some big jams and put my logging operation back to work and they’re incredibly responsive getting small jobs

reviews.name: Grady Thayer
reviews.text: I’m from Woodbury Was very amazed at the service and honesty from these guys. Got new leaf springs on my old truck they were worried about charging me an extra 100 dollars for some things that needs done the most honest shop I have ever dealt with will be back no doubt thanks Brian and Randy!
reviews.ownerReply: Grady, we certainly pride ourselves on our integrity and we really appreciate you taking the time to leave this review. Thank you for the business!

reviews.name: george denagy
reviews.text: There simply is no better place for heavy truck suspension work. The countermen have idiotic politics but they are good guys. I have been a customer for about thirty years. I highly recommend McLeod's.

reviews.name: Keeping it Real
reviews.text: Great and friendly staff, and great Quality work. Highly recommend. Be bringing my trucks back when needed as have alway been treated fairly and good.

reviews.ownerReply: Will, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a review. We're glad Randy and Billy could take care of you and your truck. Thank you for your business!

reviews.text: Best place in town for large truck, rv and car repairs. Everything from springs to plows and fabrication. Decent and friendly crew and skilled technicians who care about the customer and their families.
